blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Office of the Ombudsman on Wednesday said it has upheld its decision to file graft charges against former Guindulman, Bohol Mayor Albino Balo and five other local officials over alleged irregularities in a 2023 billboard construction project. In a statement, the ombudsman said it also affirmed the dismissal of Balo and the five other officials who were found administratively liable for grave misconduct. The five other officials are Municipal Engineer Rodney Jones Labang, Municipal Treasurer Jean Janiola, Municipal Engineer Ariston Beronio, Administrative Aide III Evelyn Hinatuan, and Administrative Aide II Dennis Theodore Besinga.
